question: Which text fields of a blueprint / blueprint book survive import_stack -> export_stack byte-for-byte, how long may they be, and what happens past the limit?
answer: blueprint.description: 500 bytes (UTF-8), longer text is silently truncated (import code 0); blueprint.label: 200 bytes (UTF-8), longer text is silently truncated (import code 0); blueprint_book.description: 500 bytes (UTF-8), longer text is silently truncated (import code 0); blueprint_book.label: 200 bytes (UTF-8), longer text is silently truncated (import code 0); blueprint_book.blueprints[0].blueprint.description: 500 bytes (UTF-8), longer text is silently truncated (import code 0); constant-combinator.player_description: 500 bytes (UTF-8), longer text is silently truncated (import code 0); decider-combinator.player_description: 500 bytes (UTF-8), longer text is silently truncated (import code 0); arithmetic-combinator.player_description: 500 bytes (UTF-8), longer text is silently truncated (import code 0); display-panel.text: 500 bytes (UTF-8), longer text is silently truncated (import code 0); train-stop.station: 1024 bytes (UTF-8), longer text is silently truncated (import code 0); constant-combinator.tags.code: no limit up to 134217728 bytes

provenance.method: headless --create; LuaItemStack.import_stack of Node-built strings, export_stack, compare. Sizes bisected in Lua with alphanumeric / U+00E9 / U+1F682 text; charset cases decoded in Node with zlib.
